tagline: Turmeric paper, every line hard left

defaults.intro: The pookalam is laid at six and the sadya at noon, on twenty-two leaves
defaults.subtitle: sadya at noon, on leaves
defaults.closing: Our door is open all day

contrastNote: Computed against bg #FAF0D8: ink #43250F 12.26:1, muted #705030 6.43:1, accentDark #8A5A12 5.21:1 - all clear 4.5:1, nothing changed. accent #A87414 is 3.58:1, so it is confined to the 52x2px rail and the lotus stroke and never carries text; the closing line is painted accentDark by the recipe, which is the ratio that passes.
idea: The lotus is the pookalam seen from directly above, drawn once at the top of a hard-left column on turmeric-washed paper, so an Onam invitation reads as a note from the house rather than a festival poster.

name: Vermilion Hairline
tagline: Bone stock inside one vermilion hairline

defaults.intro: Two years of scaffolding, and a working lift at last
defaults.subtitle: the new floor opens

contrastNote: On the bone ground #FBF7F2 — ink #1A1614 16.85:1, muted #6A5F58 5.81:1, accentDark #A5301A 6.48:1, all clear 4.5:1. accent #C8402A measures 4.66:1 and is the one accent in the library permitted to carry read text, so the closing line this recipe paints in accent needs no override; it is still held to the hairline frame, the rule and the dot-rule mark. No hex changed, and 48.6px name over 15px details keeps the 3:1 ratio.
idea: Every mark on the sheet is the same 1px vermilion at the same weight — frame, rule, dot-rule — so the red reads as one decision repeated rather than decoration added, and the near-black geometric name is left to do all the talking on bare paper stock.
